asks: What may the reason in a refusal say?
answer: The reason is always true. A refusal by a rule names what the rule refused, such as a host that is not on the list or a package younger than seven days: a rule holds even when the agent knows it. A refusal by a precaution says only that it was denied, by default, because what a precaution rests on can be fooled. You can let a precaution pass its own words on.
